event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 78 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 29.92 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,712 feet, track temperature 107 degrees.

Jeg Coughlin is 344 - 144 (70%) in Rd. 1. Cody Anderson is the 106th driver to face Jeg in eliminations

Anderson with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass of the
weekend for the win.

Coughlin with his quickest pass in the losing effort.

Erica Enders wins 86% of her Rd. 1 races when she has lane choice. Aaron Stanfield is 3 - 2 against Enders in
Rd. 1.

Enders is 15 - 10 against Stanfield in prior events. 

Enders with the starting line advantage, but had problems by half track and the car shut off.

Stanfield kept it hooked up and makes his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

The #5 PS qualifier is 17 - 5 in Rd. 1 at this event. Eric Latino is 3 - 5 in Rd. 1 this year

M. Latino is 1 - 0 against E. Latino in prior events. 

Eric goes red to give Matt the win.  Matt with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Dallas Glenn has won 26 consecutive Rd. 1 races (5th most in PS history). Stephen Bell is making his 11th
start.

Glenn is 2 - 0 against Bell in prior events. 

Bell with the starting line advantage, but Glenn chased him down by half track and never trailed from there on
for the win.  Glenn kept it hooked up and makes the quickest pass of the event.  He will have lane choice over
Aaron Stanfield.

Bell with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Dallas Glenn's MOV: 0.0153 seconds (approximately 5 feet).

In 8 races this year Matt Hartford has 5 Rd. 1 losses and 3 Final rounds. Shane Tucker has set Top Speed at
the last 2 races.

Hartford and Tucker have each won 1 times against the other in prior events. 

Hartford with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He will give up lane choice to Cody
Anderson in the next round.

Tucker with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Anderson is 16 - 1 against Delco in prior events.

Delco with a great light, but Anderson chased him down by 500 feet and never trailed from there on for the
win.  He will have a bye in the next round.

Greg Stanfield beat Troy in Rd. 1in Phoenix this year. Troy Coughlin Jr. starts the day with 100 round wins.

Coughlin Jr. with the starting line advantage, but stanfield had the difference made up by 100 feet and never
trailed from there on for the win.  Stanfield with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.  He will give
up lane choice to Matt Latino in the next round.

Coughlin with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Greg Stanfield's MOV: 0.0136 seconds (approximately 4 feet).
